title: A Ghibli side character is running your errands
dek: Not the hero, not the love interest. The small, strange, quietly essential one who was holding the whole film together.

questions.prompt: You turn up in the story as:

options.label: A fire that will not behave
A cat with opinions and a schedule
A large, quiet presence in a doorway
Someone with six jobs and no time for yours
Keeping the whole place running on almost nothing
Carrying messages nobody wants to hear
Standing very still until somebody notices
Doing the terrifying chore so the kid doesn't have to
Wildly useful and slightly on fire
Quiet, loyal, and following at a distance
A kitchen table with too much on it
options.alt: A wooden kitchen table laid with plates and cups

options.label: A ladder and a wall of books
options.alt: A tall bookshelf with a wooden ladder

options.label: A path into the trees
options.alt: A narrow path running into a forest

options.label: A wet street after everyone's gone in
options.alt: Rain falling on an empty street at night

questions.helper: Across: stay put or go and get them. Up: silent or narrating.

questions.prompt: Rank what a good side character needs.
questions.helper: First place is what you'd never leave the house without.

questions.prompt: You show up, you help, you leave.
questions.helper: Two gaps. Nobody thanks you, which is fine.
questions.template: You arrive with {a}, and leave behind {b}.

options.label: a fire that has opinions
a tray nobody asked for
a silence that takes up a chair
mud on your boots and no explanation
a warmer room
a note you'll pretend you didn't write
one gold coin and a lot of questions
a footprint and nothing else

questions.prompt: I would rather be useful than understood.
I say the thing out loud, immediately, to whoever is nearest.
The best help is the kind nobody notices.
What you're actually doing in the background:

options.label: Keeping one small fire alive
Watching who takes what
Running the errand nobody assigned
Standing between them and the door
A little bigger than you arrived
Without a word, tail up
Carrying something for someone else
Still there, technically

results.name: CALCIFER
results.tagline: A small fire doing the work of a power station
results.blurb: You are the reason the house is warm and the reason everyone is slightly nervous. You complain constantly, you threaten to leave, and you have never once actually left. Your loyalty is immense and it comes with a running commentary about how underappreciated you are, which is fair, because you are.
results.watchOut: You burn yourself down for people who never say thank you. Ask them to say it.

results.name: JIJI
results.tagline: The cat who is also your entire support system
results.blurb: You are the friend who has an opinion about everything and expresses it at volume. You are also, underneath the attitude, the one who stays up until the person gets home. You make the story funnier and the fear smaller, which is a genuinely rare skill.
strengths: Reads people faster than they'd like
results.watchOut: Not every moment needs a joke. Some moments need you to just sit there.

results.name: NO-FACE
results.tagline: Standing very still, holding everything out to you
results.blurb: You want to be included so badly that it comes out as generosity, then as too much, then as a room full of people who took what you offered and never looked at you. You are not frightening. You are just enormous and lonely and still learning how to be a person at a table.
results.watchOut: You can offer the whole world and still get left behind. Ask for what you need instead.

results.name: KAMAJI
results.tagline: Six arms, one boiler, zero patience
results.blurb: You are the engine room. Nobody visits except when something breaks, and then they need a miracle in the next ten minutes. You are extremely good at what you do, you have no interest in being celebrated for it, and your occasional soft spot is worth more than most people's grand gestures.
strengths: Takes the weird new arrival under your wing
results.watchOut: You give other people your best years. Let somebody make you tea for once.

results.name: TURNIP HEAD
results.blurb: You are the one standing slightly out of frame with a strange job and a stranger reason. People are not sure what to make of you, so they mostly leave you to it, and you use that to protect the person who needs protecting without ever explaining why.
results.watchOut: You stay invisible for so long that people forget you're there. Say something.

results.name: LIN
results.tagline: Doing the scary job with efficiency and gum
results.blurb: You are the older one who has already done the awful thing and come out the other side with a plan. You are blunt, practical and genuinely kind, and you will feed someone and yell at them in the same sentence. You are the difference between survival and a story.
strengths: Will not let you go back to bed
results.watchOut: Doing it for them is not the same as letting them do it. Step back occasionally.

results.name: HEEN
results.tagline: The messenger nobody wanted, still running
results.blurb: You deliver the news that ruins the plan and then wait around for further instructions with a sigh. You are unglamorous, indispensably loyal and deeply unimpressed by everyone. The story would fall apart in nine minutes without you and the story does not care.
strengths: Honest to the point of rudeness
results.watchOut: You take the blame that belongs to other people. Put the message down and leave.

results.name: YAKUL
results.blurb: You are the quiet companion: no dialogue, total commitment, entirely centred on getting someone else where they need to be. You are strong, steady and probably the only reason the plot arrives anywhere. You do not ask for a share of the screen.
results.watchOut: Being the vehicle for someone else's journey is a beautiful thing. Have one of your own too.
